notes.title: Compare Your Morals
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/417e71391923aea9cd381d588b073a225bacc360.png

We've released a new update to the game that now tracks player decisions, yes the stats are real!


Compare what you think is the "correct" decision to thousands of other players. Are they wrong? Are you wrong?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/b3f5c6e2a61ddbd7462715ec37f1bc4f5de8fcd3.png

We're committed to making sure that our trolley problem game  is as safe and secure as possible—we don't track or store any personal information about our users. ​Only you see your decisions and how you compare to others. When you make a decision it's recorded anonymously without any data attached to you.

We also added more problems for you to address! 20 new dilemmas which will get you thinking what should I do?

We'll be live streaming today at 5pm! 

This major update comes alongside the Made in Ontario promotion, check out all the great games!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/792598c0407bd0fde998793f174bb43458dc943e.jpg

Here are some of the biggest changes:

* You can now see stats on decisions you make in-game. We want to know which ones players agreed on and which ones generated differences in opinion.

* More moral problems! We've added more scenarios where you have to make tough choices about what's right and what's wrong, so that we can keep expanding on this aspect of gameplay and give you more difficult decisions to make.

* Faster gameplay: We've sped up the gameplay slightly so that it feels more like an engaging adventure.

* Bug fixes: We fixed some bugs that were causing crashes when certain people played the game, so hopefully those crashes will be a thing of the past!

notes.title: 2020 Retrospective Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/464e04dbd796ff9b10640f78c410b56a1feb5512.png

What if you can relive the major events of 2020 ? The Dr. wants to know what moral choices you made on key events throughout 2020.

The game is 50% off as part of the Steam Winter Sale so get it now!

20 new situations to test your 2020 morals!

So much happened this past year that you've probably forgotten key events. We reviewed 2020 on wikipedia to see which situations are the most challenging. They are in order so you can relive 2020 more or less chronologically. 

In some situations you'll find homages to cultural moments and in other situations you'll be reminded of some stupid political things from earlier in the year. And oh yea, anti-maskers show up.

Including some moments you may have missed like theAfghanistan war crimes investigations and the FinCEN Files. 

We hope this tour-de-force of the craziest year (yet) will bring you some closure.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/1a5a1e54e08a76858860883a0f28eb6d38dacb90.png

To recap, in this update:
20 NEW situations related to 2020Available to  everyone who already has the game for free, just download the new zip file.At least 20 bug fixesMaybe 20 new bugs too!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/d2d454da740896cdf7875d09c86e65ac0069232c.png

notes.title: Updated to squash the summer bugs
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/87fe284d8ad0bbc7353016968560df77c04ccf46.png

We've updated Dr. Trolley's Problem to address a whole swath of bugs that players found. With more players from the sales there were more eyes on our game, which meant more mistakes were found. Sorry about that. We're happy that people are interested in our humble game though :)

Fixes include:

Pushing people off a bridge is less buggy
Menu works even better than before
Load time improvements
Various fixes to the tutorial
Other tiny things.


Hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: More bug squishing
notes.content:
We've got more players thanks to the summer sales, which means more bugs got found, which means I tried to fix as many as I possibly could.

Fixed: 
Fat Man & The Fat Pierre situation bugs that wouldn't reset properly if you push them off and return to do the same situation again.
The game would sometimes load the wrong menu. Now it loads the right menu.
Some other tiny things.

notes.title: Dr. Trolley's Problem is COMPLETE & 25% off!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=6NpGxicakp8;full][/previewyoutube]

We did it!

To celebrate our version 1.0 milestone Dr. Trolley's Problem is 25% off!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/3df129024eb59c1aa1ba3c8e91c5d68bac553d6e.png
The full Dr. Trolley's Problem  problem sets are ready for you to play through. We have the traditional trolley problems you can play and the view-shifting AI car mode. What will you do if you have to choose between hitting a wall or a person?

You might already have the update, we pushed it to players late last week and so far no problems have been reported. 

What we found during Early Access and almost a year of lackadaisical testing.


 The trolley problem situations spurred the conversations we hoped for.
 So many bugs! Where do they come from?
 Players want more situations to struggle through.
 People enjoyed the chance-based situations after a series of serious ones. This was predictable since the inclusion of chance takes mental pressure off of the player.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/bd494c712afa333b5b3f89506469c303c534bce2.png
Tell your friends about the game and share as much as you can on the social media of your choice. Maybe you love TikTok or are going old school on MySpace, either way we appreciate your efforts!

Thanks to everybody who has supported us in this journey to a nice round 1.0 release!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/9296446b02efa1815bb410334ed4671efe5b70e9.png

notes.title: Introducing the "AI" Car Mode
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/8acbdb06629e8062d9506ea617eab10596902b15.png
Experience the joys of driving an autonomous car!

Artificial Intelligence in your hands! That's because it is your hands that will be doing all the driving. In this update the Dr. has prescribed you an autonomous car that, and much like the trolley, you need to decide what to do.

More on this mode and more randomness will be revealed next update.

Arrows are now overlaid on top of the tracks to help clarify where the trolley will go. Predicting where a thing on tracks goes proved to be too difficult for too many people.

Other noteworthy things in this release:

Even more actors to run over or save
Random situations now describe actors
Screen shake 
Menu improvements
More bugs terminate


Please keep an eye out for any more bugs that might still be sneaking around in the game.

We're almost to the full release!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/024a0e275e3ddf1c24bf462c89050c109e2d27f4.png

notes.title: Random Mode and More Situations Added
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/8f8771dc7b928d012474f2be6d04ab16dc009cb9.png

LOTS OF NEW STUFF!

The Dr.'s been hard at work over the summer crafting even more trolley problems for all you patients. While you were out enjoying the sun and hanging out with friends Dr. Trolley was hard at work on the meta-VR device to improve your game experience.

The end of summer (or is it the start of fall?) update adds more play time and stressful situations. There have been changes behind the scenes which hopefully don't cause more bugs.

There's an upcoming game mode that will hopefully blow your collective minds. It'll come out just before the 1.0 release. Stay tuned!

The highlights from the update:


Randomly generated situations!
25 new situations!
There are more actors in the game for the trolley to run over (or not).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/79e341c4e6377cf509c92ef584692f6f993bd2ef.png

More on the random situations:

The current rollout of the random situations displays actors on the tracks. Choices are only influenced by what you see - who's on the track - without any additional notes. In a future update it is planned to also generate random information about each actor to influence what people decided to do. 

If you have any feedback on the random situations (or anything else about our trolley problem game) please let us know!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829918/58616d7b177528f03c19696f7e839e2f26195bad.png

An incomplete list of changes:


New situation category
Ghosts have a bit more randomness
Rebuilt menu system 
Inorganic actors to run over
Analytics update
Loading screen (you know you love it)
More variety in ghosts

notes.title: Some quick fixes
notes.content:
This is a subtle update which will make adding more content later a little easier. Nothing much to see here. 

Modifications

 Another pass on analytics stuff

Keep playing - that's an order from the Doctor!

notes.title: Our first update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829918/8775f75e55ec6daaa7d5f92fd6b9874d9d517a77.png

We've been out for a little over a week and thanks to your efforts we've unearthed a lot of bugs and things to modify. The Doctor's been busy! 

Fun fact: since release well over 1000 ghosts have spawned in the game. Put another way, that's over 1000 beings no longer hanging out on train tracks.

This update is mostly bug fixes and some tweaking of the game. We want to get rid of as many bugs as possible before adding more situations. Not all bugs will stop more sweet, sweet, content. Tired of hearing only seven possible impact sounds? Now there are more possible impacts for your ears.   

Modifications

 Trees now have a special ghost (suggested by Veav)
 The Love situation is now earlier (swapped situations 23 & 32)
 Music volume lowered in the mixer
 Added additional impact sounds (including one for the tree ghosts)
 Situation 50 displays a thanks for playing message
 Players get a few more seconds in situation 07, 22, & 44
 Truck is slower in situation 43
 More Dr. Trolley commentary 


Bugs run over by the trolley

 One music track was causing problems, so it has been removed
 Lighting in situation 50 has been improved
 Player audio prefs should be saving properly.
 Fixed a bug that caused the game to think you made a decision if you opened the menu mid situation after making a decision and subsequently opened another situation. No idea why people do this so to solve it the menu now resets the track decision.
 Trolley could travel through blocker in situation 1, that's no longer the case.
 Situation 1 no longer gets broken if you skip the tutorial then try to play the tutorial to return to Situation 1 in order to then keep playing the game. It's as confusing as it sounds. Let's hope it works.
 Rejigged the analytics, stats still not working 100%.
 Fixed some typoos 


Still working on the display issue around the menu and screens with high resolution.

Build 0.5.5

Feel free to suggest more changes and fixes in the discussions or on Twitter.
